title: Gambeson
description: Light fabric armor. Negates 1 Injury from slashing damage.

title: Chainmail
description: Medium metal armor. Negates 1 Injury from slashing and piercing damage. -1 Effect when sneaking, running, climbing or swimming.

title: Plate Armor
description: Heavy metal armor. Negates 2 slashing/piercing Injuries and 1 bludgeoning Injury. -2 Effect when sneaking, running, climbing or swimming.

title: Buckler
description: Light metal shield. +1 Effect when defending from melee attack once per round.

title: Kite Shield
description: Large wooden shield. +1 Effect when defending from melee or ranged attack. -1 Effect when sneaking, running, climbing or swimming.

title: Dagger
description: A light one-handed piercing melee weapon. Can be thrown 1 zone away.

title: Hand Axe
description: A light one-handed slashing melee weapon. Can be thrown 1 zone away.

title: Longsword
description: A medium one- or two-handed piercing or slashing melee weapon. +1 Effect when attacking while wielded with both hands.

title: Zweihänder
description: A heavy two-handed slashing melee weapon. +1 Effect when attacking.

title: Greataxe
description: A heavy two-handed slashing melee weapon. +2 Effect when attacking multiple enemies.

title: War Hammer
description: A heavy two-handed piercing or bludgeoning melee weapon. +1 Effect against armor.

title: Mace
description: A medium one-handed bludgeoning melee weapon. 1 Injury negated by armor turns to Distress instead.

title: Morningstar
description: A medium one-handed bludgeoning melee weapon. Ignores shields.

title: Staff
description: A light two-handed bludgeoning melee polearm weapon. +1 Effect when tripping an enemy.

title: Spear
description: A medium two-handed piercing melee polearm weapon. Once per round outside your turn you can attack an enemy entering your zone.

title: Billhook
description: A heavy two-handed piercing or slashing polearm weapon. +1 Effect against cavalry.

title: Hunting Bow
description: A light two-handed ranged weapon. Range: 1-2 zones away. -1 Effect when shooting targets in the same zone.

title: Crossbow
description: A heavy two-handed ranged weapon. Range: 1-2 zones. Ignores Plate Armor. -1 Effect when shooting targets in the same zone.

title: Hand-Cannon
description: A heavy two-handed ranged weapon. Range: 0-2 zones away. Play 2 Outcome cards over 2 turns to load and fire. Add the Effect together.

title: Riding Horse
description: Can move 2 zones per turn. +1 Effect when attacking infantry on horseback.

title: Horse-Drawn Wagon
description: Can move 2 zones per turn. Capacity: 2 people in the front and up to 6 in the back. +1 Effect when defending from infantry.

title: Grappling Hook
description: +1 Effect while climbing.

title: Lockpick Set
description: Allows picking locks.

title: Bandages
description: Removes 2x Injury. Usable during battle. Consumed after use.

title: Healing Salve
description: +1 Effect when healing to remove Injuries. Not usable during battle.

title: Herbal Remedy
description: Receive a Boost or negate Poison. Usable during battle. Consumed after use.

title: Prayer Book
description: +1 Effect when practicing religion to relieve Distress. Not usable during battle.

title: Mead
description: Removes 2x Distress. Usable during battle. Consumed after use.

title: Grenade
description: Play an Outcome card to throw the granade up to 1 zone away. Damages everything in the zone. Consumed after use.

title: Lantern
description: Provides light in the current zone. Can be used in the rain. Does not count as an open flame.

title: Torch
description: Provides light in the current zone. Cannot be used in the rain. Counts as an open flame.

title: Cannon
description: A heavy explosive artillery weapon. Range: 1+ zones away. Ignores all shields and armor. Damages everything in the zone.

title: Rations
description: Food and water to sustain a person for a day.

title: Pouch
description: A pouch can store easily accessable small things. Can be attached to a belt.

title: Chest
description: A chest can store heavier things for easier transportation. Can be locked.

title: Letter
description: A letter is a convenient way of passing information.

title: Poison
description: Causes 1x Injury at the end of every Round until healed. Can be applied to a weapon. Usable during battle. Consumed after use.

title: Key
description: What does it open

title: Trap
description: Causes 2x Injury and Stuck when stepped on. Takes a Success to escape from it.

title: Tools
description: Tools for crafting.

title: Digging tools
description: Usable for mining or breaking down obstacles.

title: Ore
description: Does it contain precious metals, gems or is it just a fancy stone

title: Stone
description: An excellent building material.

title: Wood
description: Good for building, but quite flamable.

title: Iron
description: Can be used to craft something useful by a blacksmith.

title: Silver
description: Can be used to craft something pretty by a jewler.

title: Gold
description: Can be used to craft something precious by a jewler.

title: Light Weapon
description: When attacking with Success or better, you may also play a Partial Success to attack again.

title: Heavy Weapon
description: +1 Effect when attacking with Success or better.

title: Reach Weapon
description: Attacks in same or adjacent zone. On Success, prevent target’s movement next round.

title: Spread Weapon
description: Attack all enemies in your zone or an adjacent one.

title: Throwable Weapon
description: Throw to attack up to 2 zones away.

title: Precision Weapon
description: Shoot to attack up to 3 zones away.

title: Repeating Weapon
description: Attack up to 3 targets 1-2 zones away. Draw from the Outcome Deck for each enemy. Stop on Fumble.

title: Artillery Weapon
description: Play an Outcome card. At the beginning of your next turn, attack all enemies in the targeted zone with the result.

title: Light Armor
description: Reduce received Injury by 1 and convert it to a Distress.

title: Heavy Armor
description: Reduce received Injury by 1.

title: Shield
description: Convert a Partial Success into a Success when defending.

title: Healing
description: Consumable.\nRemove 1 Injury or spend an action and remove Effect +1 Injury.

title: Comfort
description: Consumable.\nRemove 1 Distress or spend an action and remove Effect +1 Distress.

title: Surge
description: Consumable.\nReceive 2x Boost.

title: Tools
description: +1 Effect on an action while using a tool to work.

title: Light
description: Lights up current zone.

title: Vehicle
description: On Move, you can move +1 zone further.

title: Package
description: Contains something important.

title: Document
description: Holds important information.

title: Valuables
description: Holds valuable items or currency.

title: Key
description: Opens something important.

title: Resources
description: Basic resources for crafting or building.
